doc.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07

title: Mac Merrimakers and the Mac bandleaders
summary: Sadie and Billie worked with trumpeter Thomas Mac, a New Orleans man who stayed in Pensacola, and Billie worked with the Mac Merrimakers at the Belmont Theater.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: Who of your sisters used to work with bands over there?
Well, I had my baby sister. She'd wake. The band with, what's her name? Wally Rankin. What's her name? Wally Rankin. He's a great saxophone player. Huh?
I was with him too. I was with him too. I was with him too.
Yeah. And, oh, she worked with different. There's no fellas over there. Different bands over there.
Who did Sadie work with?
Well, Sadie work mostly worked with, during that time.
Mac.

With Mac Merrimaker. See? Mac from out of New Orleans. And I worked with Mac for years myself over in Pensacola. But Mac and I, we was going on the road all the time. See, we was on the road. Very soon we had to clear a dance in Pensacola. We was going to go all the time.
But Mac didn't have the band himself, huh?

Yeah. Mac had the band himself. But Mac was the only New Orleans man over there. He had the band. So after he came over there and he just, you know, fell in love with the town. And he found someone he cared for over there. So he just stayed there. And by, he just got musician Ronnie Pensacola, you know. He made his own band up, you know, with the hometown.
Was Mac a band leader? Yeah.
Trumpet player.
Yeah. Oh, I see.
Yeah. Something's over the river there. Over in the, somewhere over there in the West. We don't know. Somewhere over the river.
His son is over there.

No, him. That's where he came from, over the river. That's where Mac did. Yeah. He's from here, you know. But it's over the river. I don't know what part of the river over there. I know he's across the river.
Well, I'll ask Thomas. He'll know.

Yeah. That's Thomas. He looked just like Thomas. He looked just like Thomas. He was talking about his brother. And Mac was here. Mac was here working at the Western Union's office, I believe. Last time I saw Mac, Mac came and seen me and told me he was here working at the Western Union's office. I don't know what Mac is because I'm going to run down on him no more since.
Well, I thought he just had that show. I'm thinking about Billy Mac. Is that the same?
No, I'm not talking about Billy Mac. No, this is Thomas Mac.
Thomas Mac. Yeah.
Billy Mac, I know.
Billy Mac had Mac's merry-maker.
Oh, I used to work with the Mac Merrimakers. Yeah, I work with the Mac Merrimakers. That's why I'm asking now.
Yeah.
But yeah, Mac Merrimakers, I work with them.
Why not?
I work with them.
I work with them at the Belmont Theater in Pensacola Florida.
Well, are they related?
Well, I really couldn't tell you. I don't know anything about that.
Where's Billy Mac from originally? I don't know where Billy from.
But I think Billy, I think Billy and Mary McMulls was both in Mobile, if I ain't mistaken. I believe he is, from Mobile, I believe.
Well, I'll ask Punch. He worked with them for a long time.
Yeah, I worked with them. I worked with them at the Belmont Theater in Pensacola Florida.
